name: Super Breakout
coverage: 18 devices, every one from the IC parts list in TM-118. Grid spacing is nominal — the designators are what the parts list gives, but nothing here has measured the board. A board map, not a bill of materials. 5 memory devices placed from MAME's ROM map, which encodes board positions in its file names and was checked against real boards; the chip lookup names MAME as the source for each.
